svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 04/12 Crystal Cove (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Old wooden beach cottages tucked under the bluff down the coast. The sun goes down right in front of them. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
